articles.title: ELLE FANNING, MARK HAMILL, MYRON KERSTEIN, ZOEY DEUTCH, AND WAGNER MOURA TO BE HONORED AT THE ASTRA FILM AWARDS ON JANUARY 9, 2026
articles.mainIdea: ELLE FANNING, MARK HAMILL, MYRON KERSTEIN, ZOEY DEUTCH, AND WAGNER MOURA TO BE HONORED AT THE ASTRA FILM AWARDS ON JANUARY 9, 2026
articles.summary: PR Newswire: ELLE FANNING, MARK HAMILL, MYRON KERSTEIN, ZOEY DEUTCH, AND WAGNER MOURA TO BE HONORED AT THE ASTRA FILM AWARDS ON JANUARY 9, 2026. The Hollywood Creative Alliance (HCA) has unveiled its final list of honorees for the Astra Film Awards, set to take place on January 9, 2026, at the Sofitel Beverly Hills Hotel. The ceremony will be live-streamed across multiple platforms, including the official Astra Awards YouTube channel, Instagram & X accounts, and on Knekt.tv.
